questions.explanation: Resistance scales with length squared, so 2 times 9 is 18 ohm. The slip is to multiply by three only.

questions.subject: PHYSICS_EM
questions.topic: Terminal voltage across a load
questions.stem: A historical case gives emf 20 V, internal resistance 2 ohm, load current 4.0 A; what is the terminal voltage?
questions.explanation: Terminal voltage is emf minus I r, so 20 minus 8 is 12 V. The slip is to ignore internal resistance.
